title: WL-MT402-ProviderNeutralWpLocalStoreContract
clause: Define a provider-neutral WpLocalStore contract with a strict non-authority data boundary and no engine-specific types.

conditional_execution.rejected: Do not edit product code; record validator-checked NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_MT401_REJECTION and preserve the SurrealDB-only baseline.

scope.summary: GOAL: Define the engine-independent WpLocalStore boundary used only if MT-401 is APPROVED_FOR_EVALUATION. The contract is keyed by mandatory project_id and wp_id, represents one lazily provisioned working store per Work Packet, and is shared by every session and Micro-Task in that WP. It is not a Database implementation, Locus repository, domain store, fallback or proof substitute. No public interface may expose SQL strings, Turso/libSQL types, paths, connections or transactions. If MT-401 is REJECTED, this MT records the disabled contract posture only and adds no runtime dependency.
forbidden_paths: Any public turso/libsql/SQLite type or SQL-bearing API
acceptance_criteria: WpLocalStore, WpLocalStoreBroker, WpLocalStoreKey, WpLocalRecordClass, WpLocalPromotionIntent and typed errors are provider-neutral; their public signatures contain no Turso, libSQL, SQLite, SQL statement, file-path or connection type.
WpLocalStoreKey requires non-empty project_id and wp_id. Session IDs, MT IDs, worktree IDs and process IDs can be request attribution but can never select or create a different database.
The contract is lazy: a WP without an approved working-store need returns NOT_PROVISIONED and creates no directory, file, lock, key or background task.

The allowlist is closed to immutable source-snapshot manifests, file/change inventories, bounded validation/build caches, bounded tool-result caches, drafts/candidate artifacts, promotion intents, local receipts and canonical watermarks.

The denylist explicitly rejects Notes/RichDocument, Loom/Knowledge, CKC/Atelier, Tailor, Studio and canonical Locus entities, including WP/MT status, gates, dependencies, occupancy, leases, roles and EventLedger records.

Loss, denial or unavailability of WpLocalStore cannot change SurrealDB reads, writes, readiness, gates, product behavior or completion truth; callers receive a typed LOCAL_ACCELERATION_UNAVAILABLE posture.
If MT-401 is not approved, compilation and startup prove that no engine adapter or dependency is reachable while the machine-readable rejection remains inspectable.
proof_targets: Compile the provider-neutral contract without a Turso/libSQL/SQLite Cargo feature and inspect its public rustdoc/type surface.
Run allowlist/denylist table tests against every WpLocalRecordClass and every forbidden canonical domain family.
Run identity tests proving different sessions, MTs and worktrees under one project_id/wp_id resolve one logical key while same wp_id in different projects does not collide.
Run lazy-provisioning negative tests and independently inspect the configured state root for zero side effects.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Typed backend contract only; MT-409 owns operator diagnostics. TraceProjection must expose enabled/disabled/not-provisioned without file paths or content.

target_entries: WP-local working store > Purpose and strict data boundary
WP-local working store > What remains in SurrealDB

same_project_private_resource_cases: A same-project principal without access to the source resource cannot observe its derived local record.
cross_account_negative_cases: The same wp_id under another project or account resolves to no accessible store, count or existence signal.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Every local derived record preserves the intersection of source scopes and is invalidated when that scope changes.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Revocation or AccessSpace/project switch invalidates handles and derived records before the next operation.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: The provider-neutral contract exposes no remote sync, SaaS or MCP storage route.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Caches, counts, errors, status projections and locators reveal no inaccessible existence, credentials, paths, body content or tool payload.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: The contract preserves correlation fields but cannot append canonical events itself.
Typed boundary and denylist errors must be inspectable without leaking local content.
No background broker or long-running job is created by the interface definition.

risk_if_missed: An engine-shaped or open-ended interface would make Turso irreversible, enable canonical content drift, or create one database per session/MT instead of one per WP.

risks: Provider-neutral names hide SQL or file semantics in opaque strings.
Session or MT identity accidentally participates in database selection.
A generic JSON payload field becomes a backdoor for canonical Notes, Loom or creative-domain content.
A cache miss changes readiness or product behavior instead of only performance.
minimum_controls: Closed typed record-class enum and payload size limits.
Public-surface inspection and forbidden-dependency compile test.
Canonical result equivalence with local store absent.

official_sources.title: Turso Quickstart for Rust
official_sources.finding: The official local Rust API is engine-specific and file-backed, which is why it must remain behind the provider-neutral WpLocalStore boundary.

official_sources.title: SurrealDB Rust SDK
official_sources.finding: Canonical reads and writes continue through the official SurrealDB SDK rather than through WpLocalStore.

official_sources.title: SurrealDB permissions and row-level security
official_sources.finding: Canonical project authorization remains a database-enforced record-user boundary that the local broker must revalidate.
